tests.title: No passwords, API keys or tokens in any file git can see
CVs, Drive ids and test output are kept out of git
Gemini calls per day stay far below the free daily limit, even when flooded with jobs
Every sheet write stores text as-is (RAW), so "=FORMULA" from a job ad stays plain text
Built workflows: no leftover placeholders, no credentials inside, right time zone
Gemini down for the whole run: no job is lost, the email says "delayed"
Running twice never sends the same job twice
Duplicate flood: the same job 2,000 times from 4 sources becomes one row
The people's builds don't leak into each other
No secret ever committed: the whole git history is scanned, not only today's files
Known security holes: npm advisories for n8n and every library inside it
n8n is not far behind the newest release
Google logins: warns 2 days before Google ends them (Testing-mode apps expire after 7 days)
The weekly n8n backup to Google Drive really happens
Sentinel console sends the browser protections (CSP, no framing, no sniffing, no caching)
Only Alex's Windows account can open n8n's folder (database with the logins, encryption key)
Job ads that try to order the AI around are cut out, flagged and capped
An ad cannot fake extra "### JOB" blocks or a "Notes:" line in the prompt
Second AI check (longer ad text) is filtered too
Garbage from the AI cannot break scores or touch other jobs
The AI cannot invent a blocker the ad does not contain
HTML/JavaScript in job ads never reaches the email as code
Someone editing the shared sheet cannot inject code into the email
Spreadsheet formulas in job ads are stored as plain text
Sheet links cannot make the daily check open this laptop or the home network
Broken, slow or hostile job sites cannot crash the search
Text filters stay fast on hostile input (no regex freeze)
A giant ad cannot blow up the prompt (cost and limits)
Bad command-line input to the host script is refused before anything runs
LIVE: forged requests against the Sentinel console itself
LIVE: can a device on the same Wi-Fi reach n8n?
LIVE: does the n8n API answer without logging in?
LIVE: links in the real sheets are checked against the link guard
LIVE: workflows running in n8n are exactly the reviewed build
